title: Who originated jazz: Roppolo, Brunies, Stephens, Mares and Chink vs ragtime
summary: Brunies rejects claims by others and says the New Orleans Rhythm Kings players originated jazz, while LaRocca's band played ragtime.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
